text:
Isha Rao: Quick idea — run a focused PLG micro-experiment next week. Combine free-credit sizes + curated prompt templates + a short follow-up webinar to nudge activation. Target: +12% 7-day activation for new signups.

Ben Torres: sounds good. propose 3 arms instead of 4 to save samples: $5 + baseline onboarding, $15 + prompt-pack, control (no credit). keep cohorts ~1k each.

Priya Nair: i like 3 arms. who writes the prompt-pack? we should include 4 short vertical templates: support, product search, content draft, rerank. each <6 examples.

Evan Lee: measurement: track time_to_first_generate, credit_redeemed, generate_count_day7, retention_day7. Also flag accounts that exceed 4 embedding calls -> auto-create lead in HubSpot with tag "plg-credit-activated".

Isha Rao: Priya + Ben to own templates. Evan to own tracking and routing. I'll draft experiment brief and expected lift math.

Ben Torres: UI touchpoints: in-app welcome card, email drip day0, and a 1-click apply CTA on the template gallery. add an in-app tooltip that surfaces the webinar invite on day 3 for credit redeemers.

Priya Nair: timeline check — need prompt copy by Wed so design can wire up the gallery. i'll add short usage notes for each template (what endpoint to call, recommended temperature, token cap).

growth-bot: Experiment EXP-2026-042 created. Variants: V1 ($5 + baseline), V2 ($15 + prompt-pack), V0 (control). Events prefixed with marketing.plg_credit. Funnels: signup -> credit_awarded -> first_generation -> retention_7d.

Evan Lee: routing rule: if email_domain in enterprise_domains OR estimated_seats >= 10 -> create HubSpot lead and assign queue = "SMB+". else mark as nurture. capture company_size property.

Isha Rao: webinar idea — 25-minute "Practical prompts for open models" demo + live Q&A. invite only to credit redeemers week 1. attendance bonus = $5 extra credit applied automatically. good conversion lever.

Ben Torres: agree. schedule Tue/Thu mornings. prefer 11am PT. registration link should set utm_experiment and populate user id so we can attribute.

Priya Nair: small note: add an experiment-specific onboarding checklist card that highlights 3 starter prompts and a quick task: "generate a product search result" — mark completed on first success. that'll help measure time_to_first_success.

Evan Lee: dashboard request queued (dash-2026-21). metrics by variant: redemption_rate, time_to_first_generate_median, generate_calls_per_user, retention_delta, leads_created.

Isha Rao: ok next steps: Priya -> templates by Wed EOD. Ben -> in-app/email assets by Thu. Evan -> tracking + HubSpot routing rules by Thu EOD. I'll publish brief and add to experiments board.

Ben Torres: ping me on copy reviews. i'll mock the in-app card later today.

Priya Nair: will add short usage tips and examples.

Evan Lee: will validate tracking on staging and smoke test HubSpot create.

growth-bot: Reminder set: experiment monitoring check in 3 days after launch.

Isha Rao: thanks all — keeping this tight and measurable. will post brief link when ready. :rocket:
